name: 1.4L Fryer Oil Filter Pot Carbon Steel Jug with Stainless Steel Strainer Lid
description:
Keep cooking oil clean and reusable with the 1.4L Fryer Oil Filter Pot. Crafted from carbon steel with a removable stainless steel strainer, it filters out crumbs and debris while keeping oil safe from dust and insects. The heatproof body, secure lid, and cool-touch handle make it a practical and durable choice for every kitchen.
Key Features
 1.4L capacity for oil storage
 Carbon steel pot with stainless steel strainer
 Heat-resistant, rustproof, and durable design
 Secure lid to block dust and insects
 Cool-touch handle for safe handling
 Heat-insulating tray protects countertops
Ingredients / Materials
Carbon steel, stainless steel, heat-resistant plastic handle
How to Use
 Pour used oil through the stainless steel strainer
 Store oil in the pot with lid closed
 Place on tray to prevent heat damage to surfaces
 Wash strainer and pot regularly for hygiene
Package Includes
 1 × Fryer Oil Filter Pot (1.4L)
 1 × Stainless Steel Strainer
 1 × Heatproof Tray
